message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries on global warming that you might find interesting:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore presents a comprehensive overview of climate science and the urgent need for action. |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | A follow‑up that examines progress (or lack thereof) since the first film and highlights new scientific findings. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels around the world to witness the impacts of climate change and discusses solutions. |
| **“The 11th Hour”** | 2007 | A global perspective on environmental degradation, featuring interviews with scientists, activists, and world leaders. |
| **“Climate Change: The Facts”** | 2019 | A concise, data‑driven look at the science behind climate change and its societal implications. |

If you’d like more details on any of these, or if you’re looking for something more recent or region‑specific, just let me know!
